tables.","citations":[{"index":2,"quote":"there is no mechanism to raise or lower the limit on the number of tables in a join."}]},{"claim_text":"If SQLITE_MAX_EXPR_DEPTH is compiled as 0, expression depth is unlimited.","verdict":"SUPPORTED","reasoning":"Passage [4] explicitly says setting SQLITE_MAX_EXPR_DEPTH to 0 at compile time means the depth of expressions is unlimited.","citations":[{"index":4,"quote":"If SQLITE_MAX_EXPR_DEPTH is set to 0 at compile time (if the depth of expressions is unlimited)"}]},{"claim_text":"Calling sqlite3_limit() with the sqlite3_limit call for expression depth is a no-op.","citations":[{"index":4,"quote":"then the sqlite3_limit(db,SQLITE_LIMIT_EXPR_DEPTH,size) is a no-op."}]},{"claim_text":"A web browser could use this web browser example and says sqlite3_limit() allows internal trusted databases to be unconstrained while tightly limiting databases controlled by untrusted external code.","citations":[{"index":0,"quote":"For example, a web browser application might use an internal database to track historical page views but have one or more separate databases that are created and controlled by javascript applications that are downloaded from the internet. The sqlite3_limit() interface allows internal databases managed by trusted code to be unconstrained while simultaneously placing tight limitations on databases created or controlled by untrusted external code"}]},{"claim_text":"When used with the default page size of 4096 bytes, the maximum database size is about 17.5 terabytes.","verdict":"SUPPORTED","reasoning":"Passage [5] directly states that the default 4096-byte page size gives a maximum database size of about 17.5 terabytes.","citations":[{"index":5,"quote":"When used with the default page size of 4096 bytes, this gives a maximum database size of about 17.5 terabytes."}]},{"claim_text":"At the default 4096-byte page size, a database can hold up to about 2e+13 rows.","verdict":"CONTRADICTED","reasoning":"Passage [6] associates approximately 2e+13 rows with the maximum database size of 281 terabytes, not the 17.5-terabyte size at the default 4096-byte page size.","citations":[{"index":6,"quote":"A 281 terabytes database can hold no more than approximately 2e+13 rows"}]},{"claim_text":"Raising the page size to 65536 bytes multiplies the maximum database size by 16.","verdict":"SUPPORTED","reasoning":"Passage [5] gives about 17.5 terabytes at 4096-byte pages and about 281 terabytes at 65536-byte pages; these figures are consistent with the 16x increase in page size.","citations":[{"index":5,"quote":"When used with the default page size of 4096 bytes, this gives a maximum database size of about 17.5 terabytes.
